data_source_priority.daily_kline_primary: EM push2his kline, fqt=0 AND fqt=1 both fetched from 2021-01-01; adjust_factor derived per (date) as close_fqt1/close_fqt0 ratio anchored at latest=1 — model_derived, documented

data_source_priority.oracle_route: csindex industry indices (cross-check only, never authority)

taxonomy_v1_static_declared.honest_position: no free public channel provides TRUE historical membership changes for A-share industry classification in this environment (SW blocked; no structured change history). CD-1A therefore does NOT pretend historical PIT.
taxonomy_v1_static_declared.semantics: taxonomy v1-static: membership valid_from = max(stock listing date, 2021-01-04); valid_to = null; membership_change_frequency = UNKNOWN; every artifact carrying it must display the declaration: 'static classification extended backward under the declared assumption of no intra-window reclassification; reclassifications are INVISIBLE in this build'
taxonomy_v1_static_declared.hard_rules: the snapshot is a SEED, never historical authority; any future real historical source REPLACES v1-static wholesale with a new taxonomy_version (no merging); PIT-affected analyses must cite the declaration

fields: stock coverage fraction of full-market list
historical time coverage (dates with usable daily data)
membership change frequency (UNKNOWN for v1-static, declared)
historical gaps (long empty windows per sector)
source provenance completeness (per-stock: has classification? has daily data?)
census_protocol_per_level.output: per-level census json + pass/fail vs support thresholds; mixed granularity allowed (some industries may only qualify at L1)

data1_daily_schema: listing_status(derived from first/last kline date vs window)
st_flag(not directly available from kline; recorded as GAP — candidate source: EM f10 or tencent, evaluated during acquisition)

acquisition_plan.universe: full A-share list (~5000+) from sina+csrc union
acquisition_plan.storage: per-stock gzip JSON under data/cd/daily_fullmarket/{code}.json.gz (same layout as CSR-84 store); resumable (skip existing); no file >2GB (per-stock files are KB-scale)

sector_series_feasibility_demo: from v1-static membership + DATA-1 daily, deterministically rebuild ONE synthetic series per weighting (equal/free-float-amount/amount) for a FIXED sample sector and verify rebuild determinism (two runs identical bytes) — feasibility proof only, no ranking, no conclusions

conditions.c1_historical_pit_membership_usable: at least one taxonomy usable under DECLARED semantics (v1-static declaration counts as usable-DECLARED, not as historical PIT; the gate records which)
conditions.c2_meaningful_level_support_qualified: at least one of L1/L2/L3 census PASS: stock coverage >= 95%, median sector size >= 15, single-stock sectors <= 5%, sector set with daily data covering >= 90% of window
conditions.c3_full_market_daily_same_window: DATA-1 acquired for >= 97% of list, window overlap with census window >= 95%
conditions.c4_deterministic_rebuild: synthetic series rebuild from (membership, daily) is pure function; two runs byte-identical
conditions.c5_provenance_complete: every stock traceable to source+fetch-time+content-hash; classification source recorded per stock
conditions.c6_no_future_backfill: v1-static declaration enforced on every artifact; any unqualified stock marked NO_CLASSIFICATION (fail-closed), never guessed

gate_G_CD1A_1.on_fail: deliver 'current data conditions cannot test the sector hypothesis at level X' — no sector engine is built
gate_G_CD1A_1.on_pass: CD-1B (PIT Sector Infrastructure) may be proposed, pending user GO
